summary: The candidate fixes the three-to-four-row DSA planner mismatch and its focused tests pass, but it does not establish the original issue's required safe execution extent. In particular, eager padding zero-fills out_cache_loc, the DSA forward writes every physical K row through that tensor, and the new validator accepts the synthetic cache location solely because its length matches. Thus a padded row can write cache slot 0 and overwrite real KV state. This is a partial metadata-shape fix plus test hardening, not a full original-issue fix.

tests.what_was_measured: The recorded base predicted and produced only 3 DSA metadata rows for a 3-token batch whose attention-TP physical extent is 4, reproducing the original padding mismatch (predicted_rows=3, padded_cache_rows=3).

14 focused candidate tests passed, including GPU tensor execution of the 3-to-4 attention-TP padding helper and CPU validation cases. Imports resolved to /job/repo/python/sglang; no native source changed.

The candidate predicts/pads 4 metadata rows but its validator accepts out_cache_loc=[10,11,12,0]. Source tracing confirms _pad_inputs_to_size zero-fills this tensor and DSA forward passes the full tensor and K rows to set_mla_kv_buffer.

gpu_execution.evidence: The candidate GPU regression ran on one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and ROCm 7.2.26015. This exercised GPU padding tensors, not an end-to-end DeepSeek DSA model/kernel execution.

remaining_counterexamples: A DRAFT_EXTEND_V2 batch padded from three real token rows to four physical rows gets a zero-filled synthetic out_cache_loc entry. validate_preplanned_metadata_extent accepts it because kv_rows == physical_tokens, while forward_extend writes all physical K rows using that location; the synthetic row can overwrite cache slot 0.

No executable evidence demonstrates a consistent real-versus-physical extent across actual DSA attention, indexer/top-k output, DeepGEMM scheduling, and KV writes. Shape equality alone does not prove synthetic-row side effects are safe.
remaining_limitations: No DeepSeek DSA model weights or qualified end-to-end speculative DSA fixture were available. MI350X/ROCm cannot exercise CUDA-only DeepGEMM scheduling paths, so those remain architecture-blocked. The tiny Llama serving fixture is a different architecture and cannot qualify DSA semantics. No C++ or FlyDSL files changed, repository-environment.json records native=null, and no native rebuild was applicable. Distributed attention-TP execution was not run; the deterministic mocked parallel configuration exercised its padding calculation.
